description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F01187923
Sheriff’s File # 24001057
PLAINTIFF – OceanFirst Bank N.A. Successor By Merger To Two River Community Bank vs:
DEFENDANTS- Kevin O'Donnell A/K/A Kevin J. O'Donnell, et al
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 11th day of May, 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Avon-By-The-Sea, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot 15.01, Block 19 Tax Map of Borough of Avon-By-The-Sea
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
212 Sylvania Avenue Avon-By-The-Sea, NJ 07717
Dimensions: 50 ft. x 140 ft. x 50ft x 140ft
Nearest Cross Street: Approximately 150ft from the nearest cross street known as 2nd Avenue
The occupancy status of the property is: BORROWER OCCUPIED
APPROXIMATE UPSET PRICE IS: $1,306,892.32 FOR THE SHERIFF'S SALE
The full legal description can be found in the Office of the Clerk of Monmouth County in Deed Book 9170, at Page 870
Pursuant to municipal tax search dated February 25, 2026
Subject to:
2026 Qtr. 2nd quarter taxes due 05/01/2026 $5,409.47 OPEN
2026 Qtr. 3rd quarter taxes due 08/01/2026 TO BE DETERMINED
Water; Acct. 356 1 10/1/2025 - 12/31/2025, $96.25 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; $288.75 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; OWED IN THE ARREARS
Subject to Final Reading; Subject to Excess Charges
Water: Acct. 356 0 10/1/2025 - 12/31/2025, $193.15 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; $471.19 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; OWED IN THE ARREARS
Subject to Final Reading; Subject to Excess Charges
Sewer Acct. 356 1, 10/1/2025 - 12/31/2025, $106.60 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; $318.80 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; OWED IN THE ARREARS
Subject to Final Reading; Subject to Excess Charges
Sewer Acct. 356 0, 10/1/2025 - 12/31/2025, $215.27 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; $537.36 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; OWED IN THE ARREARS
Subject to Final Reading; Subject to Excess Charges
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $1,294,353.97.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: March 11, 2026

Princeton, NJ 08540
